summary: Pin pty to 4630c5ea (was 79d526d1): the build links the pty client, core and terminal crates at 4630c5ea and builds the pty binary from it; it brings pty #197 (events --wait session_exit returns a recorded exit and fails at once for a vanished target), pty #195 (launch-operation settle retries a lock its writer let go) and pty #194 (opt-in retention for finished records, off unless PTY_RETAIN_FINISHED is set), 12 commits in all

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes in this repository; the pty client library and binary carry the pty changes listed under compatibility (event waits, settle, opt-in retention).

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites in this repository.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: The pty CLI this flake ships to every member changes one contract, `pty events NAME --wait session_exit`. For a session that already exited it now prints the recorded session_exit event (rebuilt from the record's exitCode and exitedAt when the event log is gone) and exits 0; before, it exited 1 and printed nothing. For a target that vanished without a recorded exit, such as a launcher whose daemon never started, it exits 1 at once with "vanished without a recorded exit"; before, it waited until --timeout, or forever without one. Other event types and live sessions behave as before. No code in this repository runs `pty events`; a caller on a member sees the new behavior once Operations rolls a build with this pin, and needs no change, because each case that changes used to fail or hang. crates/fractal/tests/pinned_pty.rs checks both cases against the pinned binary. pty #194 adds opt-in retention for finished records: a member's pty daemon deletes finished records past a window only when PTY_RETAIN_FINISHED is set in its environment, and nothing in this repository sets it, so it stays off. The pty flake input, the Cargo.lock git source and every pty-* dependency move from 79d526d1be4f77bb3764dc1d880492806f8a07fc to 4630c5eab3b104e8d252d550cedcdb169dccd38c together (the flake asserts they agree). The new revision contains 79d526d1, and no pty crate's dependencies change. pty commits from 79d526d1 (exclusive) to 4630c5ea (inclusive), oldest first: f137ecc feat: opt-in retention for finished registry records (PTY_RETAIN_FINISHED); 2e0eb6e docs: list retention.lost-at among the record's writers and tags; d55d764 fix(settle): retry the lock when its writer let go before the holder lookup; 821a29d fix(retention): decide again under the locks from the record as it is; 9cfc232 test(launch_operation): print the last verdict when settle never converges; 7cc3b2f Merge pull request #195 from compoundingtech/agent/settle-writer-release-race; 284c377 Merge pull request #194 from compoundingtech/agent/finished-entry-retention; 44ebf1f fix: complete lifecycle waits from recorded exit state; efad005 test: remove an exited session in wait regression; de55aad test: record measured Node event-wait defects; 2bf0c4e fix: scope vanished-target rejection to lifecycle waits; 4630c5e Merge pull request #197 from compoundingtech/schickling-assistant/2026-10-30-events-wait-exit

downtime.detail: No additional startup work in this repository. Hosts that run pty sessions keep their deployed pty until Operations rolls a build with this pin.

manual.detail: None for this change; the deploy is Operations' step after merge.

recovery.detail: Revert the pin commit to return to 79d526d1; no persistent state changes in this repository.
